audit_basis: current runtime source and frozen Phase 5 scenario configuration; not inferred from prior reports alone
common_runtime_constraints: per-step UAV speed and city boundary
radio access and link capacity evaluated by the shared network engine
actual movement, hover, and relay energy charged in Wh
battery reserve and return-energy protection remain enabled

B_phase1_static_grid.logic: one full-grid GreedyRelayPolicy search at initial observation; retain the selected target without replanning
B_phase1_static_grid.candidate_action: single destination on configured policy grid; runtime moves toward it subject to shared actuator limits
B_phase1_static_grid.planning_energy_check: historical movement-to-target plus estimated return movement and reserve; hover/service sortie is not included in the historical planner estimate
B_phase1_static_grid.runtime_safety: shared simulator still enforces actual speed, battery, backhaul, access, capacity, and city limits

Bprime_static_grid_shared_safety.logic: same initial GreedyRelayPolicy target as B, with a conservative complete sortie feasibility envelope
Bprime_static_grid_shared_safety.candidate_action: same configured grid target as B
Bprime_static_grid_shared_safety.planning_energy_check: movement, hover, relay-service horizon, return, and reserve using the shared energy helper
Bprime_static_grid_shared_safety.runtime_safety: same as B and all strategies

C_rolling_horizon_mpc.logic: scalar weighted sum of rescue service, total connected users, all-rescue recovery bonus, latency, energy, and geometric progress
C_rolling_horizon_mpc.candidate_action: hold, eight compass directions, and direct headings to feasible rescue-user/healthy-station relay locations; beam width 6
C_rolling_horizon_mpc.replanning: state-signature changes or 20-second periodic interval; execute first action then observe again
C_rolling_horizon_mpc.forecast_assumption: users, stations, radio state, and demand are frozen across each prediction window
C_rolling_horizon_mpc.hard_constraints: all common runtime constraints plus candidate return-energy check

D_lexicographic_rescue_priority.logic: lexicographic rank: rescue user-time service, feasible full recovery and predicted time, target/final rescue service, progress, ordinary service, latency, sortie energy, distance, and switching cost
D_lexicographic_rescue_priority.candidate_action: 64 coarse-grid points retained after geometric pre-ranking, plus exact relay points, rescue-cluster points, initial B reference point, current point, and last target; route, backhaul, energy, and return feasibility are checked afterward
D_lexicographic_rescue_priority.replanning: state-signature changes or periodic interval clamped to at least 60 seconds; switch suppressed unless rescue tier improves
D_lexicographic_rescue_priority.initialization: B grid target is retained as a reference/warm-start target
D_lexicographic_rescue_priority.forecast_assumption: users, stations, radio state, and demand are frozen across each prediction window
D_lexicographic_rescue_priority.hard_constraints: all common runtime constraints plus full sortie and return-reserve feasibility
